text:
taylor: Heads-up — PR #50505 is blocked. CI hung during integ shard7 on what looks like a long GC pause. Can someone approve a targeted rerun or suggest a bisect plan?

ci-bot: CI status: failed on integ/shard7. last step: run-integration-tests. job_id=ci-50505-7. logs: https://ci.example/redwood/50505/7

maya: :eyes: I can give a quick approve if rerun looks clean. Any obvious change that would trigger big memory churn?

lee: Can you paste the short tail of the worker log? curious if it's OOM or stop-the-world GC.

taylor: pasted log snippet from the failing agent below:
```
2026-03-18T14:22:10Z [worker] start test suite
2026-03-18T14:23:03Z [jvm] GC(45) Pause Full (Ergonomics)  1234567ms, 
2026-03-18T14:43:12Z [worker] no heartbeat from shard7, aborting
```
Not seeing OOM, just huge GC pause. The PR touches batching configs in serving/runtime but not JVM flags.

sam: Hmm. Could be same intermittent GC bug we've seen on big integration jobs. Best move: targeted rerun of shard7 first. If it flakes again, we bisect the last 6 commits in the PR range. I can approve rerun now.

olivia: Alternatively we can skip the long-memory integ on the rerun by setting CI env `LIGHT_MEM=true` for that job and smoke the rest. But that masks the regression if it's real.

maya: I'd prefer a clean rerun first. lee — can you run `/ci rerun --job=ci-50505-7 --targeted`?

lee: running: `/ci rerun --job=ci-50505-7 --targeted`

ci-bot: Rerun queued: ci-50505-7 (targeted). queued_by=lee, request_ts=1819991130. Estimated start ~30s.

olivia: If rerun passes, we should still add a short note to the PR about intermittent GC on heavy integ and follow up with infra to check JVM flags across pool.

taylor: ack. thanks all — pinging here so it shows up on the PR. Will add note and file an infra ticket if rerun passes.

ci-bot: Rerun started: ci-50505-7.

ci-bot: Rerun result: success. all checks green for shard7.

sam: Approved and merging in the next merge window. :shipit:

maya: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with infra about JVM tuning tomorrow.

lee: leaving a comment on the PR with the log snippet and CI link.

olivia: nice, thanks.

taylor: merging now. Thanks everyone.
